incoming.name: Bench language
incoming.excerpt: Ordinal numbers are formed by suffixing -nas4 to the cardinal, eg: od4nas4 "fourth".

incoming.name: Education in the United States
incoming.excerpt: The U.S. uses ordinal numbers for naming grades, unlike Canada, Australia, and England where cardinal numbers are preferred.

incoming.name: Georg Cantor
incoming.excerpt: He defined the cardinal and ordinal numbers, and their arithmetic.

outgoing.name: Georg Cantor
outgoing.excerpt: They were introduced by Georg Cantor in 1897, to accommodate infinite sequences and to classify sets with certain kinds of order structures on them.
